The denominators also differ: Morgan Stanley counts 'Wealth Management representatives' and has published no current count (last reported 15,950 as of December 31, 2020); Schwab publishes no advisor headcount (only Form ADV employee counts and a count of 16,000 advisory firms); Edward Jones counts 'financial advisors (actual)'; Merrill's 'total wealth advisors' spans all GWIM and Consumer Banking wealth businesses rather than Merrill alone; and Raymond James excludes advisors in its RCS division even though their client assets remain in AUA. Because neither the asset measure nor the advisor count is defined consistently across the five firms — and two of them lack a current comparable advisor count — the per-advisor comparison is not valid on this evidence.
